settings.title: Sensors and devices
settings.description: Temperature uses the HA system unit; humidity uses percentage points. The secondary sensor is available in action templates. After changing devices, update node and shutdown actions too.

data.secondary_sensor: Secondary sensor (humidity for thermostat; temperature for hygrostat)

manage.title: Controller nodes
manage.description: {count} nodes. Higher priority matches first. Lower bounds are inclusive; upper bounds exclusive. Saving leaves the controller off; enable it explicitly.

node.title: Edit a delta node
node.description: Delta = measured − target. Blank bounds are unbounded; blank modes match every enabled mode. Templates: target, current, delta, primary, auxiliaries, temperature, humidity. Each node must define complete device states; leaving a node does not undo its actions.

safe_actions.title: Shutdown actions
safe_actions.description: Runs on off, invalid/stale control sensor, no matching node and unload; also attempted after action errors. Include every device that must stop. Avoid delays and loops. Generated actions cover common toggle entities initially bound.

import_nodes.title: Import nodes
import_nodes.description: Paste the complete YAML list from an example. Imported nodes are appended. Replace device modes and entities to match your devices.

error.invalid_settings: Target must be within valid minimum and maximum limits.
error.invalid_node: Check name, bounds and actions. Lower must be below upper, and actions cannot be empty.
error.invalid_actions: Enter at least one valid Home Assistant action.
